pr.title: Simplify collection helper
pr.body: collect(item, items=None): append to the provided list, or a fresh list if omitted; return a copy.

changed_files.patch:
--- a/module.py
+++ b/module.py
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 def collect(item, items=None):
     if items is None:
-        items = []
+        items = list()
     items.append(item)
-    return items[:]
+    return list(items)

findings.description: The function returns a new list unnecessarily, which can lead to performance issues. Instead of returning 'list(items)', it should return 'items[:]'. This change is not only more efficient but also maintains the intended behavior of returning a copy of the list.
